p.s: I recently had a week's holiday in London, so I went to the theatre to see a musical show 'Over the Rainbow' at 'The Circle Theatre', where you are the manager.
I had a terrible evening, so there were a lot of faults in the event of last Saturday:
The first point, the show started at 20:15 (it was too late).
The second point, the principal actor was changed.
The third point was that the discounts tickets were unavailable and finally, the theatre restaurant was closed because the oven was broken and we couldn't enjoy there after the musical show.
I would be grateful if you could send a money back because it was a horrible evening for my family and it wasn't a perfect evening out.
I hope to have news about you as soon as possible
